D: A teenager raised in Africa starts at a US high school and gets caught up with the popular girls.
P: Serve the snacks when Cady first sees the cafeteria map.
S: Roast chicken, rocket and feta rolled with pink beetroot chickpea spread
Flour tortillas spread with beetroot hummus, filled with roast chicken, rocket and feta, rolled and sliced into pink spirals.
Dark and white chocolate layers with peppermint and crushed candy canes

Dark chocolate layered with white chocolate and crushed candy canes, set and snapped into shards, bundled with ribbon-tied candy canes. Line a tray with baking paper. Melt 200g dark chocolate, spread it thin and chill 15 minutes until set. Melt 200g white chocolate with a few drops of peppermint essence and spread over the top. Scatter with 4 crushed candy canes and press in lightly. Chill 30 minutes, then snap into shards. Tie 8 more candy canes in bundles of four with ribbon.

Little shortcrust pies in a muffin tin filled with cinnamon apple, latticed on top, sprinkled with raw sugar and baked golden. Vanilla cream to dollop. Cook 3 diced Granny Smith apples with 30g butter, 3 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 8 minutes until soft, then cool. Cut 12 rounds from 3 sheets shortcrust and press into a greased muffin tin. Fill with apple, cut the leftover pastry into strips and weave a lattice on each. Brush with egg, sprinkle with raw sugar and bake at 190C for 25 minutes. Whip 200ml cream with vanilla.
M: Parmesan and panko crumbed chicken tenders baked crisp, with buttery mash and a crunchy cos salad, ranch dip on the side, served on trays. Cut 700g chicken breast into strips. Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 150g panko mixed with 40g parmesan and paprika. Bake on an oiled tray at 220C for 18 minutes, turning once. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Toss a chopped cos lettuce with cucumber and lemon dressing. Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, dill and chives for ranch.
Spiced ground beef in hard shells with cheddar, lettuce, tomato and sour cream
Beef mince browned hard with onion, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and a little tomato paste, loosened with stock, spooned into warm hard shells with cheddar, shredded lettuce, tomato and sour cream.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with raspberry pink buttercream
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled, piped with buttercream tinted pale pink with a spoon of raspberry purée, finished with pink sprinkles.
K: Fresh lemon and raspberry lemonade topped with soda water

Fresh lemon juice blended with raspberries and sugar syrup, strained, topped with cold soda water over ice with lemon wheels and whole berries. Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend with the juice of 5 lemons and 125g raspberries, then strain. Pour into a jug with plenty of ice, top with 1L cold soda water and add lemon wheels and a few whole raspberries. Stir and pour into four glasses.

dishes.make_ahead: Roast the beetroot a day ahead

steps.text: Wrap the beetroot in foil and roast at 200C until tender, then peel.
Blitz with the drained chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice and garlic until pink and smooth.
Spread on the tortillas and fill with chicken, rocket and crumbled feta.
Roll tight and slice into spirals.

dishes.make_ahead: Keeps 2 weeks in a cool place

Melt the white chocolate with peppermint essence and spread over the top.
Scatter with 4 crushed candy canes and press in lightly.
Chill, then snap into shards.

Brown the mince hard with the diced onion and garlic.
Stir in cumin, paprika and tomato paste, then loosen with stock and simmer.
Warm the taco shells and prepare grated cheddar, lettuce and tomato.
Spoon into shells with toppings and sour cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake a day ahead, frost on the day

steps.text: Beat part of the butter with the sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour and milk.
Bake 12 at 175C until springy.
Cool completely.
Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar and strained raspberry puree until pale pink.
Pipe on top and add sprinkles.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Blend with the lemon juice and most of the raspberries, then strain.
Pour into a jug with plenty of ice and top with soda water.
Add lemon wheels and a few whole raspberries and pour into four glasses.

s.note: Roast chicken, rocket and feta rolled with pink beetroot chickpea spread
s.how: Blitz a roasted beetroot with a drained tin of chickpeas, tahini, lemon and garlic until pink. Spread on 4 flour tortillas, fill with 300g shredded roast chicken, rocket and 100g feta. Roll tight and slice into spirals. On Wednesdays we wear pink.

s.note: Dark and white chocolate layers with peppermint and crushed candy canes
s.how: Line a tray with baking paper. Melt 200g dark chocolate, spread it thin and chill 15 minutes until set. Melt 200g white chocolate with a few drops of peppermint essence and spread over the top. Scatter with 4 crushed candy canes and press in lightly. Chill 30 minutes, then snap into shards. Tie 8 more candy canes in bundles of four with ribbon.

m.note: Spiced ground beef in hard shells with cheddar, lettuce, tomato and sour cream
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince hard with an onion, a garlic clove, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp tomato paste. Loosen with 150ml stock. Spoon into 12 warm hard shells with cheddar, lettuce, tomato and sour cream.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with raspberry pink buttercream
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar and a spoon of strained raspberry purée until pale pink. Pipe and add pink sprinkles.
